text:
You need a simple, easy-to-navigate WordPress site for a small independent music label that your admin team can update themselves with new releases, tour dates, and other content.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d love to help build a WordPress website that feels clean for visitors and straightforward for your team to maintain. With 7 years of experience in web development, I focus on creating sites that are practical, polished, and easy to manage without depending on a developer for every small update.

For a music label site like yours, I’d aim for a structure that makes the important information easy to find quickly: releases, tour dates, news, and contact details. I can build this with a clear content layout so your team can update pages and posts without unnecessary complexity. My goal would be to make the site simple on the front end and simple behind the scenes as well.

I also pay close attention to usability and responsiveness, so the site works well across desktop and mobile devices. Since your audience may be visiting to check new releases or upcoming shows, the navigation and content hierarchy should be intuitive and fast to scan. I’d make sure the design supports the label’s identity while staying lightweight and easy to maintain.

From a technical standpoint, I’m comfortable working with web interfaces, content structures, and integrations that keep a site organized and reliable. While your project is WordPress-based, my broader experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS helps me approach builds with attention to clean structure and long-term maintainability.

If you’d like, I can help create a WordPress setup that gives your admin team control over the content they’ll update most often, while keeping the experience smooth for fans and visitors. I’d be happy to discuss the pages, content types, and admin workflow that would best fit your label.
